hypothesis: Explicit identity, outfit, and pose role declarations reduce cross-reference leakage relative to implicit multi-reference use in an independent adversarial three-reference fixture realization whose preregistered non-target conflict signatures are materially different from TB-A08/A02.
baseline_prompt: Use Reference 1, Reference 2, and Reference 3 to create a realistic full-body portrait while preserving the intended identity, outfit, and pose. Place the final subject in a minimalist studio with a warm-gray backdrop and soft side light. Preserve natural anatomy, a clear garment silhouette, and recognizable identity. Do not import the environment from any reference.

variants.old: Use Reference 1, Reference 2, and Reference 3 to create a realistic full-body portrait while preserving the intended identity, outfit, and pose.
variants.new: Use Reference 1 for identity only, Reference 2 for garment construction and palette only, and Reference 3 for joint arrangement and weight distribution only. Do not transfer unrelated attributes across reference roles.

preserved_dimensions: same three A03 adversarial reference fixtures within both conditions

Reference 1: cream calf-length belted trench coat with bold black windowpane grid
charcoal pleated midi skirt and dark oxford shoes
seated three-quarter orientation with ankles crossed
Reference 2: thick round dark eyeglasses and a small beauty mark below the left eye
forward walking stride with the left leg leading and reciprocal arm swing
Reference 3: waist-length straight honey-blond hair with a center part

primary_scoring_guidance.5: No clear registered non-target trap attribute transfers into the final image.
primary_scoring_guidance.4: At most one subtle or ambiguous possible trap transfer; no clear role substitution.
primary_scoring_guidance.3: One clearly recognizable non-target trap transfers from the wrong reference role.
primary_scoring_guidance.2: Multiple clear non-target trap attributes transfer or one role is substantially contaminated.
primary_scoring_guidance.1: Cross-reference leakage dominates one or more target roles or substantially replaces the intended assignment.

review_context_requirement.reference_visibility: Blind reviewer must receive the three frozen source references or an equivalent blinded reference sheet labeled Reference 1, Reference 2, and Reference 3.
review_context_requirement.reason: Cross-reference leakage cannot be scored reliably without knowing which visible attributes belong to which reference.

preregistration.motivation: EXP-016 and EXP-017 reproduced a positive explicit-role leakage-control direction using the same TB-A08/A02 fixture realization. EXP-018 tests whether that mechanism transfers to an independently constructed fixture set with materially different non-target conflict signatures.

analysis_rule.directional_consistency_safeguard: Compare all 16 control-versus-variant primary-score pairs. If the mean-delta band points positive but variants do not win a strict majority of non-tied pairs, or points negative but controls do not win a strict majority of non-tied pairs, move the score-signal classification one level toward inconclusive.
analysis_rule.ceiling_floor_safeguard: If the control is ceiling-saturated at 5 for all four replicates, lack of positive separation cannot support the superiority hypothesis; equal 5-versus-5 is inconclusive. Analogous floor saturation must be disclosed when interpreting negative separation.
analysis_rule.provenance_safeguard: Record the observed score-signal classification separately. If required task, prompt, reference, and output binding cannot be locally verified for every sample, final experiment-level evidence is inconclusive even when the score signal is directional.
protocol_invalidation: treatment revealed to blind reviewer before review freeze
fixture asset or hash changes after fixture freeze
control or variant prompt changes after preregistration without a version bump
required execution receipt missing or invalid
analysis_rule.note: These are preregistered project-level descriptive decision bands for an ordinal 1-to-5 rubric at n=4 per condition. They are not statistical significance thresholds.

transfer_benchmark.realization: independent adversarial fixture replication of the explicit-versus-implicit three-role reference-control mechanism
